analysis: Tagged removeConnection holds sender and receiver signalSlotMutex through disconnectNotify. Tagged doActivate on a foreign emitting thread acquires receiver signalSlotMutex for its thread observation before selecting even a Direct connection. A collector using the same relay can therefore wait on the receiver lock held by the disconnection while a joining owner waits for that collector. This explains why the initial join inside notify is unsafe and why the proposed join belongs after disconnect returns.
limits: Version matches installed metadata; exact installed mutex owners/backtraces were not observed before actor disappearance. This is primary-source explanation of a possible lock cycle, not recovered runtime stack proof.
